'''Dhuramav''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Quartermaster/Legends|supply officer]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Following the [[Battle of Rishi]], he was part of [[Darth Marr]]'s force that traveled to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] and established the anti-[[Order of Revan|Revanite]] [[Yavin Coalition]] along with [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces under [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Supply Officer Dhuramav appears as an Imperial Agent gear vendor in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]]. He was later removed during a gear system restructuring.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{1st}}
